caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure of a woman shown in profile, facing to the right. She has a long, narrow face with exaggerated features, including a prominent nose and chin, thin lips, and small eyes. Her skin tone is a pale peach. Her hair appears white or light blond and is styled simply, with some loose, wispy strands visible. She is dressed in a dark blue dress that features white floral or abstract patterns, along with a blue checked apron with alternating white squares, over her skirt. Her arms are crossed at her waist, and her hands are visible near the center of the composition. The overall background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, providing contrast to the detailed and colorful figure. The style of the drawing is stylized and somewhat abstract, particularly in the proportions and shapes of the figure’s facial features.
title: Wooden Doll
